query: WorkArena 的核心贡献是什么？
answer: WorkArena 提出了一个基于 ServiceNow 平台、包含 33 个任务和 19,912 个唯一任务实例的企业相关任务基准，用于评估网页智能体。
support_quote: WorkArena: A realistic benchmark of enterprise-related tasks for web agents comprising 19,912 unique task instances
title: WorkArena: How Capable Are Web Agents at Solving Common Knowledge Work Tasks?

query: WorkArena 中的任务如何验证智能体是否完成了目标？
answer: WorkArena 使用验证函数提供实时反馈，识别从轻微错误（如未填必填字段）到严重错误（如向数据库推送无效数据）的问题；同时使用手工编写的 oracle 函数作为自动完成任务的基准。
support_quote: The validation functions offer real-time feedback to agents, identifying errors ranging from minor (e.g., unfilled mandatory fields) to critical (such as pushing invalid data to the database).
title: WorkArena: How Capable Are Web Agents at Solving Common Knowledge Work Tasks?

query: WorkArena 在评估智能体时给每个任务设置的最大步数是多少？
answer: 在所有任务中，智能体每个回合最多允许 15 步。
support_quote: Max step: In all tasks we give our agents a maximum of 15 steps per episode, as in He et al. (2024).
title: WorkArena: How Capable Are Web Agents at Solving Common Knowledge Work Tasks?

query: WorkArena 上不同语言模型的表现差距如何？
answer: 在 WorkArena 上，GPT-4o 的成功率为 42.7%，而 Llama3 为 17.9%，说明不同模型之间存在明显性能差距。
support_quote: Llama3’s 17.9%. The performance disparity between LLMs is significantly more pronounced in WorkArena and WebArena than in MiniWoB
title: WorkArena: How Capable Are Web Agents at Solving Common Knowledge Work Tasks?

query: WorkArena 的消融实验发现了什么关于增加智能体特征的局限？
answer: 消融实验发现，增加更多特征并不总是更好：提示会变长，可能让较弱的模型（如 GPT-3.5 和 Llama3）不堪重负，甚至降低性能。
support_quote: More is not always better: As we gradually add more features, the prompt becomes longer and seems to overwhelm the LLM.
title: WorkArena: How Capable Are Web Agents at Solving Common Knowledge Work Tasks?
